correctness.rationale: Normal form y^2+c_i L_{i-1}L_i deduced from two contact roots on M and vanishing of y-linear term at both prescribed tangent points; smoothness follows from independent L factors. Exact local intersection order four iff c_{i+1}L_{i+1}(p_i)=c_iL_{i-1}(p_i). Multiplying the ratios yields (-1)^n; closure is necessary and sufficient. Projective uniqueness up to y scaling over an algebraically closed field proves M0,n. In characteristic two all quadratic differences are squares with nonzero common xz coefficient, so any pair has a unique length-four intersection. Standalone rational/GF8 calculations corroborate finite cases but are not relied on for all n.
